treatAsVersion.description:
#version is used to determine which set of test Types to draw from, and the app info
version will default to that value. If this value is provided, the app info version
will be set to this value instead.

typesToGenerate.description:
All test Types for version comparisons are stored within `test/src/helpers/versionDiff/testTypes`.
Within this directory, there are subdirectories for each mocked version labeled as
`<major>_<minor>_<patch>`. Any Type names within these subdirectories will be suffixed
with their version number in the same format (e.g., `SchemaChange_1_0_0`). Additionally,
if a Type is mocked as renamed across versions, its renamed counterpart will have the
same name suffixed with `_R` (e.g., `SchemaChange_1_0_0_R`).

This field should be used to specify which Types to generate for this specific test case,
**excluding the version suffix**. If a Type has a renamed counterpart across the specified
{@link version}s, the renamed Type will be automatically generated as well.

Example:

```javascript
var spec = BaseCodeAnalysis.VersionDiff.TestHelper.AppInfoSpec.make({
  version: '2.0.0',
  typesToGenerate: ['ChangeRemoveFields', 'RenameTypeAndFields'],
});
```
